weapons.name: Grenader
weapons.status: Default primary [Fan-wiki: infobox 'Price: Default', 'Level Required: 1', Category:Default]. A launch weapon: its wiki page was created 2013-05-20, in BBG's launch week, and its beta name was 'Grrnade Launcher' [Fan-wiki]. CONFLICT: the wiki's beta-era text (rev 37475, 2013-05-20) called the Bearail Gun 'the default weapon for the B-1000 class'. Today the wiki lists the Grenader as default. Unresolved [Fan-wiki]. Stat rework recorded only by a single unsourced wiki edit on 2020-11-09 (user Alphabbr, rev 77023): explosives 55-75 to 45-70, AoE 85/215 to 125/250, rate of fire 1 s to 1.5 s, ammo 3 to 4, reload 5.25 s to 5 s, projectile speed 700 to 750 u/s. The in-game patch and date are [Unverified]. A B-1000 holds it in a 2026 Steam store screenshot (screen_04) [Observed]; that screenshot's capture date is unknown. Whether it is in the 2026 build is [Unverified]. BBR: none (B-1000 did not exist in BBR). BBH: not part of B1000's listed kit [Fan-wiki].
weapons.official_text: "Got a weak arm? Fear not! This honey of a weapon does the throwing for you. Now you can sit back and relax while pelting your enemies with explosives from afar." [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Grenader
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: semi-auto launcher. It 'shoots grenades in an arc' that explode on contact with a player or any surface [Fan-wiki]. IMPACT: 'they will explode into a damaging, golden orb'; 'a rather huge and bright blast' dealing 45-70 explosive damage; AoE listed as 'Max Dmg 125.0, Min Dmg 250.0', which are probably the max-damage and min-damage radii in game units [Inference]. High self-damage risk because of the low arm position and the arc [Fan-wiki]. 'The grenades launched have a significant knockback effect when they hit airborne players' [Fan-wiki]. PROJECTILE LOOK (wiki prose only): 'The projectile looks like it's set on fire with something else rotating or orbiting it, also emitting fire' [Fan-wiki]. RELOAD LOOK: 'the barrel will look like it's charging like the Power Glove, but with strong golden light, eventually forming a golden orb' [Fan-wiki]. STATS (current wiki): rate of fire 1.5 s, ammo 4 (the usage prose still says 'ammo clip of three', an internal conflict), reload 5 s, projectile speed 750 u/s; affected by Ammo+ and Explosions+ [Fan-wiki]. MODEL [Observed: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/b1000/png/Grenader.png and png/Axecutioner.png]: a chunky cylindrical launcher fitted to B-1000's RIGHT forearm. It has an octagonal body of riveted white panels framed in orange, a black octagonal muzzle tube, a black ribbed hose arcing over the top like a carry handle, a black ribbed side panel and small orange fin spikes. [Observed: Steam screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/visuals/steam_screens/screen_04.jpg, crop at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/b1000/trfull/s04_crop.jpg]: the same white-and-orange cylinder with a black looping hose and its muzzle pointing down, carried by an orange-and-blue B-1000 (probably the Orange skin on the blue team [Inference]). The projectile and explosion were NOT observed in any image or frame I opened. Depiction for shorts: [BBG News invention] a small flaming grenade with a little spinning ring lobs in a high arc and bursts into a bright golden sphere with knockback. This matches the wiki prose but has not been checked against footage.

weapons.name: Bearail Gun
weapons.status: Unlock: 110,000 Joules, level 1 [Fan-wiki infobox]. A launch weapon: page created 2013-05-20. The wiki's beta text reads 'Gun go boom - beta description' and calls it 'the default weapon for the B-1000 class' [Fan-wiki]. Visual change: 'Upon its initial release, the Bearail Gun originally had no golden laser from the shooter to the target... SkyVu added the bullet effect in a later update' [Fan-wiki; version unknown]. Stat change in the 2020-11-09 wiki edit: explosives 55-75 to 75-90, reload 3.5 s to 3 s [Fan-wiki]. It appears in a B-1000 shot of the 2026 Steam trailer, which is probably reused 2013 footage [Observed; Inference]. Whether it is in the 2026 build is [Unverified]. BBH (2024): the wiki lists B1000's attack as 'Shock N Claw + Bearail Gun' [Fan-wiki]. Official BBH copy says only 'twin functionality attack ... offers both range and melee' [Canon].
weapons.official_text: "This devastating laser creates a colossal explosion upon impact. Anything this powerful takes time so keep the enemies in your sight while it builds up. Trust us, vaporizing your friend has never been more fun!" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Bearail_Gun ; beta text quoted by the wiki: "Gun go boom" [Fan-wiki]
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: it 'charges for 1 second, with a glowing gold light, then fires a fast and short beam laser'. The shot is hitscan: 'no travel time, infinite range', zero dispersion and no zoom [Fan-wiki]. IMPACT: 'exploding with a large AoE, emitting particles and light. It also produces a dim light wave'; 'a colossal explosion upon impact with any surface or player'; explosives 75-90 (prose says 70-90), AoE 90/220 [Fan-wiki]. Ammo 1, which Ammo+ does not change; reload 3 s. The charging light shows even while the user is cloaked [Fan-wiki]. MODEL [Observed: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/b1000/png/Bearail_G.png, png/B-1000Skin.png, png/Gold1000.png, png2/B-1000_default.png]: a long rectangular arm-gun on the RIGHT forearm, with a black core, an orange frame along its length, white end panels and a small round port underneath. In the idle pose it is often held vertically, muzzle up, and in Bearail_G.png its tip glows orange. FIRING [Observed]: the official in-game 'B1000 BATTLE PACK' banner (File:B1000battlepackbundle.png, wiki upload 2015) shows a thin, straight yellow-gold beam leaving the muzzle and ending in a starburst of yellow sparks. In thumbnails of the fan 'Bearail Gun Demonstration' (YouTube 4OtByuL2bI4, a 2014 Everyplay clip) the HUD reads ammo '1 / 1'; in hq3 a 'RELOAD' prompt shows with an orange-yellow fiery burst ahead of the gun. CONCEPT [Observed: png/B-1000_concept_1.png]: under 'B-1000 PRIMARY ATTACKS ... Bearail Gun' the sheet shows 'Charge-up' (a round emitter with a red glowing core), then a large red glowing orb, 'then a quick particle blast' (a red beam hitting a silhouette). The concept is red, while the wiki and the 2015 banner show gold. TRAILER [Observed: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/visuals/trailer.mp4 at 4.45-4.6 s, strip at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/b1000/trfull/strip_4.45-4.95.jpg]: B-1000 points it point-blank at a Demo just before the claw kill. No clean beam shot is visible in the trailer.

weapons.name: Energy Overflow
weapons.status: Unlock: 60 Gas, level 1 [Fan-wiki]. A 60 Gas price is visible in a v2.7 store screenshot (File:SRCG.jpg) [Observed]. Released in BBG 2.3, Sept 27, 2013 [Fan-wiki Updates]. A fan video's description (Aug 28, 2013) quotes '2.3 (Beta) Release Notes ... New Weapons -B-1000: Energy Overflow, Shield' [Unverified as SkyVu text]. 2.6.1 (Jan 4, 2014): 'Assault will no longer fire Energy Overflow on respawn' [Game text via wiki, Updates transcription]. The 2020-11-09 wiki edit changed: charged damage 130 to 140, reload 6 s to 4 s, stat modifier '10% Health Reduction' to '+10% Speed Modifier'. A 2026-09-20 wiki edit (Alphabbr; same day as closed playtest #4) added 'Charge Time 3' with no source [Fan-wiki]. 2026 build presence: [Unverified]. BBH (2024): the wiki lists Energy Overflow as B1000's ULTIMATE [Fan-wiki]. The official site says only 'his lethal Ultimate, which boasts stun capability' [Canon].
weapons.official_text: "Sometimes you have hold it in and wait for the right moment, then release all over your enemy. What? I'm talking about this energy shotgun. What'd you think I was talking about?" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Energy_Overflow (note the innuendo when deciding audience suitability)
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: a chargeable 'energy shotgun'. Uncharged, it fires 2 shots of 45. A full charge (3 s) fires one blast of 140 that empties the clip. A partial charge uses 1 ammo, which regenerates [Fan-wiki]. All shotguns use hitscan spreads per the Weapon Statistics page [Fan-wiki], so it is probably hitscan [Inference]. CHARGE LOOK: 'particles converge on the barrel of the gun'; 'Once fully charged, orbs of light will appear at the tip of the barrel' [Fan-wiki]. SHOT LOOK: 'a single golden burst of damaging energy' [Fan-wiki]. Very short range, reload 4 s. Damage+ affects only the uncharged shot [Fan-wiki]. CONFLICT: the current infobox says '+10% Speed Modifier', but the usage prose says '10% health reduction' and the Weapon Statistics page lists it among negative Health modifiers [Fan-wiki]. MODEL [Observed: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/b1000/png/EnergyOverflow.png]: a short, wide cylinder on the right forearm with white and orange armour plates, a grey hexagonal muzzle and a ring of small cyan lights around the muzzle rim. The store and HUD icon shows a finned version with three white fins and glowing cyan inner panels [Observed: png2/SRCG_s.png list icon; YouTube gL12RHDQ_mI maxresdefault]. A SkyVu-watermarked concept sheet (File:B1000_weapons2-3-787x1024.png) shows an orange/black/white cylinder with fold-out white fins carrying cyan glowing panels and a hex muzzle ringed with cyan dots [Observed]. FIRING [Observed, low-res: fan 'Energy Overflow Demonstration' thumbnails, YouTube gL12RHDQ_mI hq2/hq3/maxresdefault]: short yellow-gold streaks fly toward the target and a yellow oval glow sits on the floor ahead of B-1000; ammo reads '2 / 2'. PRE-RELEASE [Observed: File:Imageedc.jpg, 2013-09-01]: 'ENERGY OVERFLOW EQUIPPED' shown on the Gold skin with a flat grey untextured placeholder model; the image's origin is [Unverified].

weapons.name: Super Rapid Chain Gun (SRCG)
weapons.status: Released in BBG v2.7, Jan 23, 2014 [Fan-wiki page]. The wiki's Updates list for 2.7 omits it, but it appears in a v2.7 store screenshot [Observed: File:SRCG.jpg, 'BUY NOW 100' gas]. Price: 100 Gas at v2.7 [Observed]. The wiki infobox has said 60 Gas since the 2020-11-09 edit, while its prose still says 'It costs 100 Gas' [Fan-wiki]. The same 2020 edit changed: damage 8 to 5, explosive 5-7 to 2-4, rate of fire 0.09 s to 0.08 s, reload 5.7 s to 5.25 s, Ammo+ +4/+7 to +5/+10, and added dispersion 0.06 [Fan-wiki]. 2026 build presence: [Unverified]. No BBR or BBH equivalent.
weapons.official_text: "Everything about B1000 is loud and explosive, so why not give him a chain gun that fires explosive bullets?" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Super_Rapid_Chain_Gun
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: full-auto minigun with 'wind-up and wind-down delays' [Fan-wiki]. It fires explosive bullets with a 'noticeable AoE' (50/100), dealing 5 direct plus 2-4 explosive. Ammo 40, rate of fire 0.08 s, dispersion 0.06, reload 5.25 s [Fan-wiki]. The Bass Cannon page calls the SRCG hitscan [Fan-wiki]. MODEL [Observed: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/b1000/png/SRCG_(r).png and png2/SRCG_s.png, both on the Silver skin]: a wide orange-and-white drum on the right forearm with stacked, stepped concentric rings narrowing toward the front, an orange end cap with a small black square port with several holes, and a cyan light window on the side. The store icon shows a tiered, drill-like gold/silver barrel tip [Observed]. The bullets and their impacts were NOT observed. Depiction for shorts: [BBG News invention] a rapid stream of small tracer rounds, each popping in a tiny orange-gold puff, with an audible spin-up and spin-down.
image_leads: File:SRCG.jpg https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/battlebears/images/0/05/SRCG.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20140124013942 (v2.7 store, primaries list with prices)
File:SRCGdmg1.jpg and File:SRCGdmg2.jpg (Damage+ equipment panels; not the weapon itself)

weapons.name: Lightning Bolt
weapons.status: Released in BBG 2.7, Jan 23, 2014 [Fan-wiki Updates]. Unlock: 150,000 Joules, no level lock [Fan-wiki]. The 2020-11-09 wiki edit changed: damage 48 to 50, rate of fire 1 s to 2 s, reload 5 s to 6 s, Damage+ +3/+6 to +2.5/+5 [Fan-wiki]. 2026 build presence: [Unverified]. No BBR or BBH equivalent.
weapons.official_text: "Pew pew pew Lightning Bolt! What no explosion? At least it fires quickly and packs a whallop!" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Lightning_Bolt
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: 'will fire a purple bolt of damaging energy'. It is fully accurate hitscan, 'with no AoE, projectile or travel time', semi-automatic and sniper-like [Fan-wiki]. The wiki puts it in Category:Automatic even though its prose calls it semi-auto. Damage 50, ammo 3, rate of fire 2 s, reload 6 s. No explosion; the official text jokes 'What no explosion?' [Game text via wiki]. MODEL [Observed: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/b1000/png/Lighting_bold_(cr).png, Silver skin]: a rounded orange-and-white arm cannon. Its black octagonal muzzle holds a glowing CYAN lens, a cyan light strip with dots runs along the side, and a small black scope or tube sits on top. A similar rounded orange cannon with a cyan glow appears in png/Image4_x3.png. The bolt was NOT observed. Depiction for shorts: [BBG News invention] an instant, jagged purple bolt from muzzle to target with a brief crackle, and no explosion on hit.
image_leads: File:Image4.PNG (likely the same cannon in the background) https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/battlebears/images/1/1a/Image4.PNG/revision/latest?cb=20150705194620

weapons.name: Bass Cannon
weapons.status: Released in BBG 2.20, May 29, 2015 [Fan-wiki Updates]. Level 10 lock [Fan-wiki]. Price: a 2015 store screenshot on its wiki page shows 'BUY NOW' 100 gas [Observed: File:Bass_cannon_.jpg]. The wiki infobox has said 60 Gas since the 2020-11-09 edit, which also changed AoE 100/200 to 75/150 and stat modifiers '-10% Health;+10% Speed' to '-10% Health' [Fan-wiki]. It was missing from the class page until 2020-11-09 [Fan-wiki]. 2026 build presence: [Unverified]. No BBR or BBH equivalent.
weapons.official_text: "Blow your opponents away with the Bass Canon! Explosive melody that does aoe damage " [Game text via wiki; the 'Canon' misspelling is in the original per wiki trivia] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Bass_Cannon
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: 'a continuously-firing projectile weapon that emits cyan sound waves that explode on contact'. Each wave does 10 direct damage plus 10-20 explosive in a small radius (AoE 75/150) [Fan-wiki]. Ammo 20, rate of fire 0.25 s, projectile 1,200 u/s, reload 4 s, -10% health [Fan-wiki]. AUDIO: 'It plays a generic dubstep loop that is paused and continued as the player stops and starts firing' [Fan-wiki]. 'Rarely, the Bass Cannon can blow your enemy away if they are hit by it while in midair' [Fan-wiki]. MODEL [Observed: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/b1000/png/Bass_cannon_.png]: a dark olive/black cylindrical cannon on the right forearm with an orange middle band, dark-blue rectangular windows and two round black ports. Its muzzle face is a speaker- or turbine-like disc: curved white vanes over a pale-blue cone. The sound waves were NOT observed.

weapons.name: Last Resort
weapons.status: REMOVED per the wiki. On 2020-11-09 (rev 77032) a wiki editor headed the page 'NOTE: THIS WEAPON IS REMOVED' and changed 'is the default secondary' to 'was the default secondary'. In the same session the editor changed Smoke Screen from 100,000 Joules to 'Default' [Fan-wiki]. No version, date or SkyVu note for the removal was found [Unverified]; it happened sometime before Nov 2020, i.e. before BBG 3.0 (Nov 2021). A launch weapon: page created 2013-05-19 [Fan-wiki]. It is still visible as the backpack in 2014 fan demo thumbnails [Observed]. 2026: [Unverified]. No BBR or BBH equivalent.
weapons.official_text: "Winning takes sacrifice, and in this case that means blowing yourself up. Press and hold the fire button initiate a self-destruct sequence, wait 3 seconds and then boom!" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Last_Resort
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: hold fire to start a self-destruct. The official text says 3 s; the wiki's usage prose says 4 s. Moving or releasing cancels it and starts a 3.5 s reload [Fan-wiki]. IMPACT: B-1000 explodes, dealing 200-400 explosive damage with AoE 200/400, 'the highest damage of any explosive weapon in Battle Bears Gold'. The user dies, which counts as a suicide [Fan-wiki]. Explosions+ +20/+40. Bug: Jump Pad launches go further while it is active [Fan-wiki]. MODEL [Observed: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/b1000/png/Last_Resort.png, png2/Last_resort.png, png2/Last_Resort-Figure_2.png]: a BACKPACK of two stacked orange boxes with black panels. Each box holds a large dark, round speaker-like disc plus small round dials, with white triangle accents. The same pack appears on B-1000's back in the fan demo thumbnails YouTube 4OtByuL2bI4 and gL12RHDQ_mI [Observed]. The countdown and the explosion were NOT observed. Depiction for shorts: [BBG News invention] the orange pods flash and beep for a beat, then a huge golden blast, and B-1000 breaks into chunky parts (BBG kills break bodies into chunky pieces; see Notes).
image_leads: YouTube 4OtByuL2bI4 and gL12RHDQ_mI thumbnails (pack worn in play)
sources: wiki diff rev 75833 to 77032 (2020-11-09) and Smoke Screen rev 68137 to 77035

weapons.name: Metal Crush
weapons.status: A launch weapon: page created 2013-05-19 under the beta name 'Leap N Destroy' [Fan-wiki]. Price history: 100 gas in the v2.7 store [Observed: File:Satellite_.jpg and File:Smoke_screen.jpg list]; 2.20 (May 29, 2015) 'Metal Crush reduced from 100 gas cans to 70 gas cans' [Game text via wiki, Updates transcription]; 60 Gas in the current wiki (2020-11-09 edit) [Fan-wiki]. Reload timing changed in v2.0, v2.2 and v2.3 [Fan-wiki trivia]. The 2020 edit also changed explosives 70-90 to 70-110, AoE 150/300 to 125/400 and reload 5.1 s to 5 s [Fan-wiki]. An official 'TOOLS OF DESTRUCTION' bundle sold Shock N Claw, Metal Crush, Rusty Devil and Iron Bear for '375 GAS' [Observed: File:Assaultsale.jpg, wiki upload 2013-08-31]. It is worn in the Steam trailer [Observed]. 2026 build presence: [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "Render the space between you and your opponent meaningless in the most lethal and awesomest way possible." [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Metal_Crush
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: 'the Assault will leap through the air at high speed at the angle of roughly 35 degrees before landing'. Hitting a wall drops him straight down [Fan-wiki]. IMPACT: 'the Assault class uses its left arm to smash the ground, creating a damage-dealing golden shockwave that spreads out like the splash made by the Happy Hour'. It deals 70-110 explosive (prose says 55-110) with AoE 125/400. He is immobile for 2.5 s after landing, then a 5 s reload follows [Fan-wiki]. MODEL [Observed: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/b1000/png/Metal_Crush.png]: a back unit of two riveted white plates, like folded wings, over orange lower sections perforated with round holes, on a black centre spine with an orange core. LEAP [Observed: Steam trailer /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/visuals/trailer.mp4 at 2.45-3.85 s; frames /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/b1000/trfull/strip_leap.jpg, trfull/t_2.75.jpg, trfull/t_3.3.jpg]: B-1000, wearing this pack, crouches forward, then goes airborne with a large orange-yellow flame burst at his back and sails across the arena with an orange glow behind him. I infer this is the Metal Crush leap and that the perforated orange sections act as thrusters [Inference]; the wiki does not mention flames. The landing and golden shockwave were NOT observed because the trailer cuts away.

Steam screenshot screen_04.jpg (pack on the orange/blue B-1000)

weapons.name: Energy Barrier
weapons.status: Released in BBG 2.3, Sept 27, 2013 [Fan-wiki Updates]. Beta name 'Shield': the wiki page was created 2013-09-02 as 'Shield', and the fan 2.3-beta video description lists 'B-1000: Energy Overflow, Shield' [Fan-wiki; Unverified]. Unlock: 120,000 Joules [Fan-wiki; Observed in the v2.7 store list]. The 2020-11-09 wiki edit changed: duration 6.0 s to 2.0 s, ammo 1 to 2, reload 4.5 s to 5 s [Fan-wiki]. 2026 build presence: [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "Make those pesky bullets less pesky with this brand new shield! Upon activation all damage recieved is reduced by 50%!" [Game text via wiki; 'recieved' as quoted] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Energy_Barrier
weapons.mechanics: EFFECT: self-buff. 'All damage received will be weakened by 50%' for 2.0 s. 'When activated, the player will begin to glow their team coloured' [Fan-wiki]. Status Effects page: 'Damage Resistance — No overhead icon shown. Players affected receive 50% less damage. Effect stacks' [Fan-wiki]. Ammo 2; the 5 s reload starts on activation; equipment does not affect it [Fan-wiki]. MODEL [Observed: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/b1000/png/Energy_barrier.png]: a rounded black-and-orange BACKPACK. Four white hexagonal pods at its corners each hold a dark, round grille-like emitter, with mirrored white-and-orange chevron shapes in the centre. CONCEPT [Observed: png/B1000_weapons2-3-787x1024.png, SkyVu Entertainment watermark, 'ENERGY BARRIER & ENERGY OVERFLOW']: handwritten notes read 'Shield emits from Sides', 'Shield emits from top when opened/initiated' and 'opens to emit Shield', alongside orange/white/black colour variants. The in-game team-colour glow was NOT observed.

weapons.name: Smoke Screen
weapons.status: Released in BBG 2.7, Jan 23, 2014 [Fan-wiki Updates]. It cost 100,000 Joules in v2.7 [Observed in the store list on File:Satellite_.jpg and File:Smoke_screen.jpg; Fan-wiki pre-2020]. Since the 2020-11-09 wiki edit it is listed as the DEFAULT secondary, with cooldown 2.0 s to 1.0 s and reload 5.0 s to 3.0 s [Fan-wiki]. I infer it replaced the removed Last Resort as default; the date is unknown [Inference]. 2026 build presence: [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "B1000 has his own version of hide and seek. It is called: Hide in smoke and then kill everyone!" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Smoke_Screen
weapons.mechanics: EFFECT: 'the Smoke Screen will instantly release a huge, harmless white cloud' that disorients enemies, especially in small enclosed areas. It lasts 5.0 s, with ammo 2, cooldown 1.0 s and reload 3.0 s [Fan-wiki]. 'Unlike the Sniper's Fairy's Dust, it can only be activated directly from the Assault's backpack' [Fan-wiki]. notes:
I built B-1000's (Assault) arsenal from the wiki's class page and all 14 weapon pages, and checked the looks against images and trailer frames. Two things are missing: SkyVu's archived patch notes (unreachable today) and any 2026 weapon list (none exists publicly).

ARSENAL AND ERAS
- Wiki class page (https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Assault_(BBG)) lists 14 weapons. Primary: Grenader, Bearail Gun, Energy Overflow, Super Rapid Chain Gun, Lightning Bolt, Bass Cannon. Secondary: Last Resort (removed), Metal Crush, Energy Barrier, Smoke Screen, Satellite. Melee: Axecutioner, Shock N Claw, Primus Sword. "Assault (BBG)/Weapons" is an empty stub, and none of the 5 "_unassigned" pages belongs to the Assault.
- Launch kit (BBG 1.0, May 24, 2013): Grenader, Bearail Gun, Last Resort, Metal Crush, Axecutioner, Shock N Claw. I inferred this from wiki page creation dates of 2013-05-19/20 [Fan-wiki; Inference]. It matches a wiki-hosted screenshot of SkyVu's BBG FAQ (File:Assault_Class_announced.jpg), which reads "New Assault Class: The B-1000! -9 Skins Available -2 Primary Weapons -2 Secondary Weapons -2 Melee..." [Observed; original page not checked].
- Later additions per the wiki's Updates transcription [Fan-wiki]:
  - 2.3 (Sep 27, 2013): Energy Overflow and Energy Barrier.
  - 2.7 (Jan 23, 2014): Lightning Bolt, Smoke Screen, Satellite. SRCG is missing from that list, but its own page says v2.7 and it appears in a v2.7 store screenshot.
  - 2.20 (May 29, 2015): Bass Cannon.
  - 2.21 (Jul 3, 2015): Primus Sword.
- Early beta names [Fan-wiki]: Grrnade Launcher (Grenader), Leap N Destroy (Metal Crush), Ax time / Axe Time (Axecutioner), Shield (Energy Barrier).
- Unshipped concept: File:B-1000_concept_1.png, titled "B-1000 PRIMARY ATTACKS", also shows "focus Rods", red eye-lasers [Observed]. Nothing shows it was ever released.
- Most current wiki stats come from one unsourced editor (Alphabbr) in a sweep on 2020-11-09/10. Before that, values date from 2013-2019. Per-weapon status fields give old-to-new values. The edits reflect the BBG 2.5x era, not 2026. I found no SkyVu note behind any of these changes, including Last Resort's removal.
- BBG 3.0 (Nov 15, 2021) per the wiki's transcription: "All +1 Equipment has been removed except Speed +1"; "Equipment Slot 2 has been removed". The +1 rows in the equipment tables therefore no longer apply [Fan-wiki].
- Class template [Fan-wiki]: added in BBG 1.0; health 180 (200 before 2020); forward speed 215; description "A mysterious foe ... transmitting their data to the bad guys."

BBR, BBH AND 2026
- BBR: B-1000 never existed in BBR. The BBR 1.4.3 notes (Apr 15, 2013) say only "Coming soon to Battle Bears!! ★ NEW Character Class- the B-1000! A robot made to kill." [Game text via wiki]. An April 2013 Facebook teaser shows a red-eyed silhouette and "BATTLE BEARS COMING SOON" [Observed: File:17819_10152742464095174_1895889212_n.png]. BBG itself began as the 2.0 rebrand of BBR.
- BBH (2024):
  - Official site (fetched 2026-10-15): "B1000s twin functionality attack 'Slice n Bite' offers both range and melee, a powerful combo. The former, paired with his lethal Ultimate, which boasts stun capability., makes B1000 a dangerous foe on the battlefield." [Canon] https://battlebears.com/pages/characters
  - Wiki: attack "Shock N Claw + Bearail Gun", Ultimate "Energy Overflow", 1200 Shards, March 2024. The Oct 14, 2024 notes say "B1000 Ranged Attack Damage Increased (+15%)" [Fan-wiki].
  - "Slice n Bite" is the wiki's name for Huggy's attack, so its use for B1000 is probably a copy error [Inference].
- 2026: Steam names "ASSAULT: B-1000" and claims "80+ PRIMARY WEAPONS 60+ SECONDARY WEAPONS 50+ MELEES" [Canon], with no per-class list.
  - JustNubz's showcase description says it covers "all skins, taunts, primaries, secondaries, and melee in the closed playtest of BBG (the 4th one)" [fan upload]. I did not view it, and the chapter-thumbnail URLs in the page HTML return 404. Its maxres thumbnail shows a build label "3.0.5_2026.11.19_B1" on a Heavy menu screen [Observed].
  - Wiki edit 2026-09-20 added Energy Overflow "Charge Time 3" with no source.

THE LOOK ACROSS THE KIT [all Observed in the images cited per weapon]
- "The only class that displays all of its weapons all the time" [Fan-wiki]. Every render shows the same layout:
  - Primary is built onto the RIGHT forearm. The "Falling Apart" taunt agrees: "his right arm, the one that carries his Primary weapon, suddenly snaps off" [Fan-wiki].
  - Melee is built onto the LEFT forearm.
  - Secondary is a BACKPACK module. B-1000 holds nothing in his hands.
- Weapon colours stay the same on every skin: orange, white and black hardware with cyan accents. Skins recolour only the armour. The exceptions are the Primus Sword (pink and silver) and the Bass Cannon (olive and blue).
- The 2D class portrait (File:B-1000.png, File:Assaultimage.jpg) draws the claws on the viewer's left and the gun on the right, the mirror of in-game. Don't copy its arm layout.
- Signature promo loadout: Bearail Gun + Shock N Claw + Metal Crush backpack. It appears in the 2013 pre-launch Sky View gameplay shot (File:B-1000.jpg), File:B-1000_default.jpeg, most store renders and the Steam trailer. BBH's kit matches it [Inference].
- Steam trailer (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/visuals/trailer.mp4): the B-1000 segment runs 1.5-6.5 s.
  - Its Graham, Tillman and Oliver cards match the 2013 BBG trailer (rfAyqVJrli4) thumbnails, so this footage is probably 2013 [Inference].
  - Kill result [Observed]: BBG kills break bodies into chunky separate pieces. See the trailer at 4.95-5.3 s and red pieces flying in Steam screen_04.
  - Rainbow streaks fan up from a pink target at 3.3-3.85 s [Observed]. I could not tell what caused them.
- Splash size from wiki AoE numbers, largest to smallest (probably max/min-damage radii [Inference]): Last Resort 200/400, Metal Crush 125/400, Grenader 125/250, Satellite 125/250, Bearail 90/220, Bass Cannon 75/150, SRCG 50/100. Lightning Bolt and Energy Overflow have no AoE.
- Never observed: Grenader shell and golden-orb blast, SRCG rounds, purple Lightning Bolt, cyan Bass Cannon waves, Metal Crush landing shockwave, Energy Barrier glow, smoke cloud, Satellite missiles, Last Resort blast.

ERRORS IN /home/user/thallo-site/bbg-news-repo/characters/b-1000.md
1. "Defaults: Grenader, Last Resort, Axecutioner": the wiki has marked Last Resort removed since 2020 and lists Smoke Screen as default. This is era-dependent.
2. "gun-arm = Grenader [Inference]": the long orange-and-white gun-arm in the default screenshots (B-1000Skin.jpg) is the BEARAIL GUN. The Grenader is a cylinder with a black hose handle.
3. "blue energy blade [Observed]": this is the Shock N Claw's three cyan claw-blades, not a single blade.
4. The prompt pack says "left forearm a heavy axe blade with a glowing cyan edge" and "orange-and-white grenade-launcher arm". This mixes two weapons. The Axecutioner is a grey axe with no glow; the cyan belongs to the Shock N Claw. Pick one consistent loadout: wiki defaults (Grenader + Axecutioner + Smoke Screen) or the signature (Bearail + Shock N Claw + Metal Crush).
5. "Satellite circles him like a pet" is invention. In every image the Satellite is a back-mounted orb in an orange cradle, and nothing documents it floating free. Keep the label.

DEMO RESEARCHER LEAD (Bearzooka conflict)
- In the trailer at 3.9-4.95 s, a green Demo wearing a blue bandana fires a salmon-red launcher with orange window panels and grey checkered end caps [Observed: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/b1000/trfull/t_4.0.jpg]. That fits the wiki's "red and orange lines" better than green with hazard stripes. That it is the Bearzooka is [Inference].
